summary: Tested httpOnly cookie auth migration end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed. Frontend: login sets access_token cookie with httpOnly+secure+sameSite=Lax, no token in localStorage, /me works via cookie, session persists across refresh, dashboard loads.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning in console for Test Announcement dialog)

action_items: Minor: Add aria-describedby/Description to DialogContent components to silence React a11y warnings (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py /login sets cookie via response.set_cookie with httponly, secure, samesite=lax, max_age=86400 as specified. /verify-otp also sets cookie similarly.
dependencies.get_current_user correctly prioritises cookie then Authorization Bearer (backward compat).
/auth/logout deletes cookie and invalidates active_session_id in DB.
Session-rotation on new login still works correctly with cookies (old token rejected with 401).
CORS allow_credentials=True confirmed working (browser sends/receives access_token cookie across preview domain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie auth migration verified. Use test_cookie_auth.py as regression. When running pytest, export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env first (no default is used). Playwright verified: Set-Cookie on /api/auth/login has HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax; access_token cookie visible in context.cookies() with httpOnly=True, secure=True; localStorage has no token; /api/auth/me returns 200 on page reload; dashboard renders at /admin.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 and Set-Cookie access_token with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax
Backend: Invalid credentials do not set cookie
Backend: GET /api/auth/me works via cookie only (no Authorization header)
Backend: Authorization Bearer header fallback still works
Backend: No cookie + no header returns 401
Backend: POST /api/auth/logout clears cookie (Max-Age=0/expires) and invalidates session
Backend: Multiple sequential requests reuse cookie
Backend: New login invalidates old session token (401 on old cookie)
Frontend: Login API 200 and cookie set in browser (httpOnly, secure, sameSite=Lax)
Frontend: localStorage contains no auth token
Frontend: Page reload keeps user logged in; /api/auth/me returns 200
